reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and firstWeekdayOccurrence with a holidays parameter and keeps all sites on the existing isDailyWeekendSkipping/getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test is one exported predicate used everywhere; each site still has to thread its own holidays argument through, and the per-site skip/move branching (pre-existing) is kept rather than collapsed.

placement.why: The day classification and the move rule live in shared/schedules.ts; server sites only pass their config's holidays.

scope.why: Touches only the weekend rule, its callers, the recur-config plumbing and the RecurConfig type.

maintainability.why: A clear generalisation of the weekend move to a step loop with a shared predicate, though the getDatesInRange padding heuristic (2 + 3 per holiday) is ad hoc.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts decides which days are avoided and getDateWithSkippedWeekend decides the move; getNextDate, firstWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template all call them.
